# QueueFlow Platform Information
# https://queueflow.io

> QueueFlow is an enterprise SaaS queue operations platform providing multi-counter management, atomic sequence token issuing, queue re-ordering, service assignment stopwatches, and database-driven throughput analytics for commercial counters, healthcare clinics, and service operations.

## Key Capabilities
- Multi-queue partitioning with customizable prefix numbering (e.g., CS-001, BIL-001).
- Atomic sequence counter increments on MongoDB Atlas.
- Live queue rearrangement for waiting customers (Move Up, Move Down).
- Single-serving counter enforcement with CALL NEXT and COMPLETE SERVICE flows.
- GDPR right-to-erasure compliance and tenant data isolation via JWT authentication.
